title: UFO MP -1766 BLUE GALAXY, 1766 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: high relief, blue antique finish, selective gilding, fluorescent paint, digital printing

descriptionPlain: Description Coin with the ability to levitate – literally floating Limited edition that will quickly disappear from the market Gold plating gives the coin a unique character A proven, bestselling coin concept presented in a fresh new for Following the spectacular success of the first flying UFO MP-1766 coin, which completely sold out on the day of its release, we proudly present the next extraordinary edition – BLUE GALAXY. This unique coin takes you on a fascinating journey into cosmic mysteries, showcasing entirely new, galactic decorations inspired by the phenomenon of unidentified flying objects. Will you manage to secure this limited and extraordinary coin for your collection?
